description: This Java source file defines the ImeTrigger class, which implements the Trigger interface to facilitate switching to a voice input method (Voice IME) in an Android application. It includes methods to start voice recognition, check if the Voice IME is installed, and retrieve relevant input method information.

classes.name: ImeTrigger
classes.description: A class that triggers voice recognition by switching to the Google Voice IME in an Android environment.

methods.name: startVoiceRecognition
methods.description: Switches the input method to the Voice IME for voice recognition, given a language parameter.

methods.name: isInstalled
methods.description: Checks whether the Voice IME is installed and available on the device.

methods.name: getVoiceImeSubtype
methods.description: Retrieves the voice subtype for the Voice IME.

methods.name: getVoiceImeInputMethodInfo
methods.description: Finds and returns the InputMethodInfo for the Voice IME.

methods.name: onStartInputView
methods.description: An empty override method called when input view starts; in this context, it does nothing.
